resources.string: A quick tour of the keyboard and its settings. You can skip it at any time.
Tap a key to play it. Use several fingers for chords, or slide across keys for a glissando.
All 88 keys at a glance. Tap or drag to move the visible window.
Move the visible keys by one key or a whole octave.
The leftmost visible note is shown here.
More options live here. Let\'s take a look.
Unlike the keyboard, this screen can rotate to portrait.
Choose how many white keys fit on screen.
Point plays the key under the centre of your fingertip. Area plays every key your finger covers enough of.
In Area mode, set how much finger overlap a key needs to sound.
Replay this tour from here whenever you like.
